candidate.answerReason: Feeding 15 children uses 3 cans. The 2 remaining cans feed 6 adults, agreeing with choice B.

methods.label: Find the remaining cans
methods.explanation:
First find how many cans the children use. Since each can feeds \(5\) children, feeding \(15\) children requires
\[15\div5=3\text{ cans}.\]
That leaves \(5-3=2\) cans. Each remaining can feeds \(3\) adults, so the soup can feed \(2\cdot3=6\) adults, choice \(\mathrm B\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary division, subtraction, and multiplication with clearly identified units.
